title: Should you normalize RGB values by 255 or 256?
summary: This article explores whether to divide RGB values by 255 or 256 when normalizing 8-bit color channels (0-255) to floating-point range (0.0-1.0). The author examines the trade-offs between these two approaches and their implications for color accuracy in image processing and computer graphics.
problem_solved: Clarifies the correct divisor (255 vs 256) for normalizing 8-bit RGB values to floating-point format.
why_valuable: Helps developers avoid subtle color quantization errors and make informed decisions when implementing image processing or graphics pipelines.
